  • Projetar e evoluir sistemas com foco em automação , direcionados à eficiência operacional do grupo SBF;
  • Garantir funcionalidade, manutenibilidade, escalabilidade e qualidade , aplicando boas práticas de engenharia e testes;
  • Trabalhar em um ambiente colaborativo, com pair programming, feedbacks contínuos e cultura de alta performance .


O que você precisa para essa posição no jogo

  • Proficiência avançada em Python (orientação a objetos, concorrência, boas práticas de código);
  • Experiência com arquiteturas distribuídas e microsserviços;
  • Conhecimento em Docker & Kubernetes para implantação escalável de modelos e serviços;
  • Conhecimento em observabilidade e monitoramento aplicados a sistemas de IA e automação;
  • Sólida prática em testes unitários, integração e validação de modelos;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em ambiente multifuncional e colaborativo , com autonomia;
  • Embasamento teórico em ciência de dados, aprendizado de máquina e boas práticas de engenharia de software (DDD, design de código, paradigmas);
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).


Seria legal se você conhecesse

  • Google Cloud AI/ML Services (Vertex AI, AI Platform);
  • Continuous Integration & Delivery aplicados a ML (CI/CD para pipelines de dados e modelos);
  • Ferramentas de processamento de dados em streaming (Kafka, Pub/Sub);
  • Boas práticas de DataOps e integração com times de dados e automação.

title: Especialista de Produtos - BANKING - EXCLUSIVA PCD
description:
No papel de especialista de produtos, você atuará como um parceiro importante dos Product Managers, Product Designers e dos Desenvolvedores, ao identificar oportunidades de melhoria no fluxo de abertura de conta, criar e medir experimentos, fazer estudos e acompanhar as principais métricas. Você também terá um papel importante na avaliação de parcerias estratégicas com outras empresas/fornecedores com o objetivo de impulsionar as aberturas de conta e a efetividade dos processos relacionados à gestão do cadastro/conta.

Responsabilidade e atribuições:

  • Analisar a jornada de abertura de conta de clientes PJ para identificar oportunidades de melhoria de conversão.
  • Atuar em conjunto com os Product Managers e Designers na geração de experimentos, como testes A/B, desde a definição de hipótese até a análise dos resultados e recomendações.
  • Atuar em conjunto com os Product Managers na definição de métricas de sucesso da jornada do cliente, assim como na realização de análises que expliquem a evolução das mesmas.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes de Tecnologia e de Dados para garantir a qualidade e consistência das fontes de dados.
  • Fomentar uma cultura data-driven principalmente no time em que está atuando, mas também influenciando a BU como um todo.
  • Acompanhará ciclo de vida do cliente/conta na visão de dados (Onboarding, Cadastro, atualização e revalidação cadastral, Gestão de documentação, Bloqueios e Encerramentos de contas.
  • Elaboração/ apresentação de materiais executivos

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Sólida experiência com análise de dados aplicada a produtos digitais, incluindo desde a definição do problema e das hipóteses até a realização da análise propriamente dita. Experiência com processos de aquisição de clientes é um diferencial.
  • Domínio de SQL e de ferramentas de análise de dados como Databricks, assim como experiência em ferramentas de visualização de dados (ex: Tableau, PowerBI). Domínio de Python é um diferencial
  • Experiência com experimentação e testes A/B, incluindo o desenho do teste e avaliação dos resultados, assim como a análise estatística associada a isso.
  • Capacidade analítica avançada.
  • Habilidade de comunicação com diferentes audiências, tanto com perfis técnicos quanto não-técnicos
  • Capacidade de influência, tanto através do exemplo, quanto através de números e argumentação.
  • Formação em Engenharia, Computação, Estatística ou algum outro ramo de exatas.

title: Notion Expert
description:
Overview

We are seeking an experienced Notion specialist to design, implement, and optimize a comprehensive workspace that will serve as our central hub for contacts, data management, and team workflows.


Key Responsibilities

  • Audit our current processes and recommend a scalable Notion structure.
  • Build and customize databases for large volumes of contacts and information.
  • Create clear, intuitive dashboards for day-to-day use and reporting.
  • Integrate Notion with other tools (Google Workspace, automation platforms, etc.).
  • Develop best-practice guidelines and train the team to maintain and update the workspace.


Requirements

  • Proven track record setting up advanced Notion systems for teams or businesses.
  • Strong understanding of database design, automation, and cross-platform integrations.
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills.
  • Ability to work independently, meet deadlines, and deliver a polished final product.


Engagement

  • Freelance or short-term contract (remote).
  • Flexible start date; estimated project length to be discussed.


If you have the skills and creativity to build an efficient, scalable Notion workspace, please send your portfolio or examples of previous Notion projects along with a brief introduction.

title: Compliance Specialist
description:
Compliance Specialist

We are seeking a remote, full-time SOC 2 Compliance Specialist with expertise in SaaS environments and proficiency in using compliance management platforms (preferably Vanta). The ideal candidate will lead the client's SOC 2 compliance efforts, streamline evidence collection, ensure continuous monitoring, and support security and compliance programs to meet industry standards and customer expectations.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, enhance grid health, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • SOC 2 Compliance Management : Lead the end-to-end process for achieving and maintaining SOC 2 compliance, including scoping, evidence collection, control implementation, and audit preparation using Vanta's platform
  • Vanta Platform Utilization : Leverage Vanta's AI and automation tools to streamline compliance workflows, monitor controls, and manage vendor risk assessments
  • Continuous Monitoring : Implement and oversee continuous monitoring processes to ensure ongoing adherence to SOC 2 requirements and other relevant frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001, GDPR)
  • Policy Development : Develop, update, and maintain security and compliance policies, procedures, and documentation within Vantas' centralized platform
  • Vendor Risk Management : Utilize Vanta's Vendor Risk Management (VRM) solution to assess and monitor third-party vendors, ensuring compliance with security standards
  • Audit Support : Collaborate with external auditors to facilitate smooth and efficient SOC 2 audits, utilizing Vanta's tools to provide real-time evidence and reporting
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Work closely with engineering, IT, and product teams to integrate compliance requirements into SaaS product development and operations
  • Training and Awareness : Conduct training sessions for employees on SOC 2 compliance requirements and best practices for maintaining a secure SaaS environment
  • Reporting and Metrics : Use Vanta's reporting features to track compliance metrics, generate reports, and communicate the company's security posture to internal stakeholders and external clients
  • Stay Updated : Keep abreast of evolving compliance frameworks, security standards, and Vanta platform updates to ensure alignment with industry best practices


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 3+ years of experience in compliance, information security, or risk management, with a focus on SOC 2 compliance in a SaaS environment
  • Hands-on experience with Vanta or similar compliance automation platforms
  • Proven track record of successfully managing SOC 2 audits and implementing controls
  • Strong understanding of SaaS architecture, cloud security, and data privacy principles
  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks, such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or NIST CSF
  • Proficiency in using compliance automation platforms for evidence collection, continuous monitoring, and vendor risk management
  • Excellent project management and organizational skills to manage complex compliance initiatives
  • Strong communication skills to liaise with technical teams, auditors, and leadership
  • Detail-oriented with a proactive approach to problem-solving and process improvement


Desired Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., CISA, CISSP, CRISC, or SOC 2-specific training)
  • Familiarity with Vanta's AI Agent and other advanced features for GRC automation.
  • Experience working with startups, mid-market, or enterprise organizations in a SaaS environment
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are committed to delivering world-class remote resources that enable our valued client team members to work effectively and efficiently. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Contact Center Executive - Customer Service
description:
About Us:


HBX Group is the world’s leading technology partner, connecting and empowering the world of travel. We’re game-changers, disruptors, the people who bring together local and global brands in accommodation, transport, activities and payments through our network of 300,000 hotels worldwide, 60,000 hard to reach high value clients such as tour operators, travel agents and loyalty schemes across 140 source markets. We are tech-driven, with a customer-first philosophy, and commercial teams whose knowledge and relationships on the ground are second to none. And of course we have an amazing team! Our people, Team HBX Group, are the beating heart of the company who we encourage to ‘move fast, dream big and make the difference’ every day. In fact, we believe that it is tech + data + people that truly sets us apart in the market, alongside our ‘global approach, local touch’ mentality. We’re headquartered in Palma, Mallorca and employ around 3,500 people worldwide.


We are seeking a Global Contact Center Executive to join our dynamic Contact Center team. In this role, you will support our clients and suppliers, contributing to one of our core missions: delivering unique holiday experiences to our customers . This opportunity is open to candidates currently residing in Jundiaí .


Role Overview

The primary responsibility of this role is to assist clients—including tour operators, travel agencies, and end customers—with their inquiries, liaise with suppliers, and manage bookings in alignment with the standards and procedures of the Operations Department. The goal is to address client needs efficiently and effectively.


Key Responsibilities

  • Engage with callers in a professional and enthusiastic manner, representing HBX Group with excellence.
  • Provide accurate and helpful information in response to client inquiries.
  • Document all call activity clearly and accurately in the Back Office system.
  • Respond promptly and precisely to online and email requests.
  • Monitor and manage bookings, including reservations, special requests, amendments, and cancellations.
  • Escalate issues appropriately, following Contact Center protocols.
  • Maintain high standards of service quality and professionalism.
  • Meet established Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
  • Adhere to all company policies and procedures.
  • Follow assigned schedules and adapt to changes based on call volume.


Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Strong customer service orientation and active listening skills.
  • Proficiency in English (spoken and written).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, with attention to grammar and clarity.
  • Problem-solving mindset with persistence in resolving issues accurately and efficiently.
  • Ability to follow detailed instructions independently.
  • High attention to detail and adaptability.
  • Consistent focus and enthusiasm throughout the work shift.


If you are passionate about customer service, communication, and creative problem-solving, we encourage you to apply today!


Note: Only candidates currently living in Jundiaí will be considered for this position in the Hybrid Model.



At HBX Group, we believe that diversity drives innovation and makes travel a force for good. We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected, embracing different backgrounds, perspectives and talents. Join us and be part of a team where diversity and equal opportunities really do make a difference

title: Sr. Applications Developer (Salesforce)
description:
We are looking for a Sr. Applications Developer (Salesforce) who will be responsible for developing complex business needs and providing technical solutions for our Salesforce ecosystem. This person should be flexible to adopt or learn new tools to map the growing business processes as the need arises. This role will report into IT Business Systems team. This role will help positively impact our commercial sales, marketing, agronomy, finance, supply chain, IT & other key business functions with smart, forward-looking solutions and operational efficiency.


Responsibilities:

  • Administer, design, develop & support Salesforce Platform (Sales, Service, Marketing/Pardot, Experience Cloud)
  • Take ownership of release cycles to implement and deploy new/updates to existing applications and code.
  • Develop Apex (classes and triggers), experience building Custom User Interface, including Visualforce pages/Lightning pages, Aura Components and Lightning Web Components.
  • Design and develop sites using Experience Site Builder and customization of experience site interface.
  • Design and develop custom workflows, approval flows as fits the business needs and prepare solution design documents, data flow diagrams, test cases etc. as needed.
  • Adhere to Salesforce best practices, maintain code documentation, and write / maintain test classes for all custom development.
  • Work directly with business (Commercial Sales & Marketing, Agronomy) understanding the business requirements & provide timely and apt solutions.
  • Closely work with extended IT team developers to design, develop, test, implement & support system solutions primarily in Salesforce Platform.


Qualifications and Experience

  • 7+ years of hands-on development & design experience with Salesforce Platform is a MUST
  • Experience implementing and developing in Apex, LWC/Aura/Visualforce is a MUST
  • General web development experience with HTML, CSS, JavaScript is a MUST
  • Experience working with large data sets, Salesforce API’s and bulkification is a MUST
  • Excellent analytical and debugging skills is a MUST
  • Knowledge of IT SDLC and SOX methodologies is MUST
  • Experience with mobile publisher, Salesforce maps are a big plus
  • Experience with ERP, Datawarehouse, BI/Tableau tools are a big plus
  • Ability to work as part of IT team with clear verbal and written communication
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, and Information Systems is preferred

title: Sales Specialist
description:
Join the Virtual Latinos Community!


With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.


Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?

Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the Week!


Job Title: Sales Specialist


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates: $1,000 - $1,280 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates: $2,000 - $2,560 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $12,5 - $16 depending on level of experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.


Work Schedule: The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.


Job Summary: The Sales Assistant will be responsible for generating leads, nurturing prospects, and closing sales for the U.S.-based companies. The ideal candidate will be results-driven, relationship-focused, and experienced in B2B/B2C sales processes. This role involves prospecting, lead qualification, product demonstrations, and maintaining client relationships to drive revenue growth in a remote environment.


Job Tasks:


  • Lead Generation: Research and identify potential customers through various channels and databases.
  • Prospecting: Conduct outbound calls, emails, and social media outreach to qualify leads.
  • Sales Presentations: Deliver product or services demos and presentations to prospects via video calls and phone.
  • CRM Management: Track leads, opportunities, and customer interactions in CRM systems.
  • Pipeline Management: Monitor sales pipeline, forecast revenue, and report on sales metrics.
  • Client Relationship Management: Build and maintain long-term relationships with existing customers.
  • Market Research: Analyze market trends and competitor activities to identify opportunities.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with marketing and customer success teams to optimize sales processes.


Qualifications:


  • 1+ years of related sales experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
  • Strong negotiation and closing abilities.
  • Experience with B2B or B2C sales processes.
  • Self-motivated and results-oriented mindset.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • A quiet, private workspace with reliable internet connection.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Software:


  • CRM systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, etc.)
  • Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, etc.)
  • Video conferencing tools (Zoom, Teams, Google Meet)
  • LinkedIn Sales Navigator
  • WhatsApp Business
  • Sales engagement platforms (Outreach, SalesLoft, etc.)
  • AI tools (flexible)
  • Open to other tools as needed


Languages:


  • English mandatory (C1level)
  • Spanish mandatory


Next Steps:


  • Send your easy apply
  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers
  • Apply to job offers of your interest
  • Get interviewed
  • Start working in your dream job!

title: Desenvolvedor full stack Pl (.Net)
description:
Buscamos um Engenheiro Full Stack de nível pleno a sênior motivado para se juntar à nossa equipe. Nesta função, você trabalhará no desenvolvimento front-end e back-end, contribuindo para o design, implementação e manutenção de nossos aplicativos/produtos. Os candidatos ideais devem ter sólidos conhecimentos de .NET, JSON, C#, Arquitetura de Microsserviços, CI/CD, SQL, Oracle/MongoDB, RabbitMQ e experiência com frameworks como React. Fortes habilidades de resolução de problemas e vontade de aprender são essenciais. Esta é uma ótima oportunidade para desenvolver suas habilidades e avançar em sua carreira em um ambiente acolhedor.


Requisito:


  • Inglês fluente.



Habilidades Técnicas:


  • .NET Core: Domínio de ambos os frameworks é essencial para o desenvolvimento backend.
  • React: Fortes habilidades em React e UIX para desenvolvimento frontend.
  • Desenvolvimento de API RESTful e Arquitetura de Microsserviços: Capacidade de desenvolver e consumir APIs com eficiência.
  • JSON: Proficiência em trabalhar com JSON.
  • Serviços em Nuvem: Experiência com plataformas em nuvem para implantação e gerenciamento, como KOB.
  • DevOps e CI/CD: Familiaridade com integração contínua e pipelines de implantação usando ferramentas como Git, etc.
  • Testes Unitários e TDD: Fortes habilidades em testes unitários e desenvolvimento orientado a testes.
  • Tecnologias de Banco de Dados: conhecimento em Mongo DB e/ou PL/SQL, Oracle, Entity Framework e outros sistemas de gerenciamento de banco de dados.
  • Outros: Kafka, Grafana, Splunk.


Habilidades Não Técnicas


  • Resolução de Problemas: Capacidade de solucionar problemas e questões técnicas complexas.
  • Gestão de Projetos: Compreensão de metodologias ágeis.
  • Comunicação: Habilidades de comunicação eficazes para colaboração com membros da equipe e stakeholders.
  • Adaptabilidade: Capacidade de aprender e integrar novas tecnologias e frameworks rapidamente.

title: Clinical Site Manager
description:
Clinical Site Manager – (Ophthalmology & Neurology Focus)

Location: Remote-based


We’re partnering with a global biopharmaceutical company dedicated to advancing treatments in Ophthalmology, Neurology , and other complex therapeutic areas. To support several ongoing and upcoming studies, we are seeking a Clinical Site Manager to oversee key investigator sites across LATAM .

This position is offering a unique opportunity to blend operational oversight with strong relationship management at the site level.


Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary sponsor contact for assigned sites and CRO monitors, ensuring high-quality communication and collaboration.
  • Oversee site management activities across multiple studies, including start-up, monitoring, and close-out phases.
  • Drive patient recruitment and retention initiatives, fostering engagement with Principal Investigators and site coordinators.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Mobile
description:
A TribeMD Assist busca um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Mobile proativo(a) e talentoso(a) para atuar no desenvolvimento e manutenção de seu aplicativo, com foco em experiência fluida, segura e de alta performance para médicos e pacientes. A vaga é para trabalho presencial em Lajeado (RS) ou remoto.


Principais responsabilidades:


  • Desenvolver e manter funcionalidades para iOS e Android.
  • Otimizar desempenho, corrigir bugs e garantir estabilidade.
  • Colaborar com designers UX/UI e equipe de back-end.
  • Garantir qualidade do código com boas práticas, testes e code reviews.
  • Gerenciar publicações nas lojas (App Store e Google Play).
  • Participar ativamente das cerimônias ágeis. 


Requisitos obrigatórios:


  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento mobile.
  • Proficiência em React Native, Flutter ou nativo (Swift/Kotlin).
  • Conhecimento em APIs RESTful, JSON, gerenciamento de estado e Git.
  • Familiaridade com publicação em iOS/Android.
  • Boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe. 


Diferenciais:


  • Testes automatizados, CI/CD, integração de módulos nativos.
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis ou no setor de saúde (Health Tech).


Benefícios:


  • Salário competitivo.
  • Ambiente inovador, colaborativo e com foco em autonomia.
  • Oportunidades de crescimento profissional.


Ideal para quem é apaixonado por mobile e quer impactar positivamente a saúde digital.

title: Senior IT Technical Recruiter – LATAM Based
description:
Aptonet Inc. is seeking experienced Senior IT Technical Recruiters to join our world-class recruiting team. This role is based in Latin America (LATAM) and will focus on sourcing, screening, and placing top technical talent. You will recruit LATAM-based candidates for U.S.-based companies and also support U.S.-based recruiting efforts for our U.S. clients.

Our recruiting team builds the foundation of our clients’ success by connecting them with extraordinary talent who share our vision and values.


What We Look For

  • 3-5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, ideally in an agency setting or a high-growth tech environment .
  • Proven experience recruiting for diverse Information Technology roles .
  • Understanding of technology trends and a passion for working with technical professionals.
  • Strong ability to multi-task , manage multiple roles, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent communication skills – both written and verbal – in English; Spanish and/or Portuguese is a plus.
  • High level of professionalism, integrity, and customer service focus.
  • Proficiency with tools such as Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook , and modern ATS systems.


What You’ll Be Doing

  • Manage the end-to-end recruitment process , including sourcing, screening, interviews, feedback, offers, and onboarding.
  • Build strong pipelines of both LATAM and U.S.-based technical candidates using creative sourcing strategies.
  • Leverage a variety of sourcing tools, including internet research, Boolean search strings, LinkedIn, ATS mining, and cold calling .
  • Evaluate applicants by comparing qualifications to job requirements and conducting initial screening interviews.
  • Post job advertisements across relevant platforms such as LinkedIn, Dice, CareerBuilder , and niche tech sites.
  • Partner closely with hiring managers and internal teams to understand role requirements and deliver top candidates quickly.
  • Maintain data accuracy in the ATS and track recruiting metrics for reporting and continuous improvement.
  • Develop scalable recruiting processes to support the growth of our recruiting operations in LATAM and the U.S.
  • Act as a trusted representative of Aptonet , promoting our values and delivering a high-quality experience to both candidates and clients.

title: Business Developer PtX
description:
Leap29 are partnering with a leading international Independent Power Producer (IPP) entering Brazil’s renewable energy market. They are seeking a Business Developer to drive growth in Power-to-X (PtX) and green hydrogen projects. This is a remote role, but candidates must have a strong understanding of the Brazilian market, with established networks and local expertise to identify and develop new opportunities.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Conduct market, regulatory, and economic research to identify viable PtX and green hydrogen opportunities in Brazil.
  • Evaluate potential projects, sites, and partners during the screening phase.
  • Support early-stage project risk assessment and feasibility analysis.
  • Develop preliminary financial forecasts and investment models to guide strategic decisions.
  • Collaborate with internal and external teams to assess alignment with company goals.
  • Leverage existing networks to gather market intelligence and insights.


Key Requirements:

  • Proven experience in business development for PtX, green hydrogen or related derivatives.
  • Good knowledge of PtX, green hydrogen, and renewable energy markets in Brazil.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and maintain relationships with local stakeholders in Brazil.
  • Ability to evaluate opportunities and conduct early-stage project analysis.
  • Strategic thinker with a proactive approach to identifying business opportunities.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish would be a plus)
  • Able to work remotely from Brazil, with occasional travel as needed.


Join a leading European IPP expanding into Brazil’s green hydrogen and PtX market. Leverage your local expertise, work with an international team, and help shape the future of renewable energy.


Ready to take on the challenge? Apply today!

title: Principal AI Engineer - AI in Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE


We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.


In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.


Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.


Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:

Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care

Automated coding and billing optimization

Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials

Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements


Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.



WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU


This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.


You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


Very hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!


1. Build and Refine AI Products

Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers

Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy

Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions


2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy

Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough

Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products

Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy


3. Own the Development Lifecycle

Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production

Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards


4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement

Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process

Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space

In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base



REQUIRED EXPERTISE


1. Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go

Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)

Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)

Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency

Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications

Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)


2. Mindset & Approach

Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment

Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly

A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team

Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing


3. Highly Valued Qualifications

Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar

Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change

Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures

Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)

Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management


Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.



WHAT WE OFFER


1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity

Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential

Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions

Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale


2. Professional Excellence

Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans

Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems

Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure

Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside


3. Work-Life Integration

Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones

Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily

Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients

Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability



READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?


If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.



Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

title: Desenvolvedor full stack
description:
A Exadel está procurando um Desenvolvedor Fullstack de Nível Intermediário (Java + Angular+ Quarkus) . Este profissional contribuirá tanto nas tarefas de desenvolvimento back-end quanto front-end, enquanto também desempenha um papel na garantia da qualidade do produto por meio de testes e validação. O foco será na entrega de recursos robustos, validação de integrações FIX, construção de interfaces de usuário e suporte a testes automatizados, tudo em estreita colaboração com a equipe sênior.


Responsabilidades:

Desenvolver e manter aplicações usando Java + Quarkus no back-end e Angular no front-end. Entregar funcionalidades, correções de bugs e melhorias na interface com atenção ao desempenho e à usabilidade. Criar, executar e manter testes automatizados (unitários, de integração, ponta a ponta). Garantir a qualidade do código e contribuir para manter uma alta cobertura de testes em toda a pilha. Colaborar em atividades de QA, validando tanto requisitos técnicos quanto de negócios. Fornecer suporte na resolução de problemas de aplicações em produção de baixa/média complexidade. Trabalhar em um ambiente ágil e colaborativo, interagindo com equipes de negócios, produtos e tecnologia.


Experiência prática com Java 11+ e Quarkus (RESTEasy, Panache, MicroProfile). Conhecimento sólido de Angular para desenvolvimento front-end. Experiência básica a intermediária com o protocolo FIX. Experiência com JUnit, RestAssured ou outros frameworks de automação de testes. Compreensão de APIs REST e desenvolvimento de aplicações web. Conhecimento de SQL e bancos de dados relacionais. Familiaridade com Git e pipelines de CI/CD.

title: Lead SRE Engineer
description:
About the Company:

Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.


About the Role

We’re seeking an experienced Lead Site Reliability Engineer to join our growing team in Brazil. In this role, you’ll partner with product teams to tackle critical infrastructure challenges, acting as both a hands-on technical expert and a mentor.

You’ll help design, build, and operate cloud platforms while driving reliability, performance, and security across the engineering organization.


Responsibilities

  • Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Guide and support engineers, foster technical excellence through code reviews and design discussions, and help unblock complex challenges.
  • Documentation & Standards: Create and maintain runbooks, standards, and best-practice guides to strengthen operational capabilities.
  • Infrastructure as Code & CI/CD: Automate provisioning and deployments using Terraform and best-practice pipelines (GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, etc.).
  • Reliability Engineering: Define SLIs/SLOs, manage error budgets, and build dashboards and alerts to proactively monitor system health.
  • Security & Compliance: Enforce least-privilege IAM policies, automate vulnerability scans, and maintain audit logging.
  • Monitoring & Observability: Instrument services with metrics, logs, and distributed tracing to enable rapid troubleshooting.
  • Cost Optimization: Implement tagging strategies, right-size resources, and use data-driven insights to manage cloud spend effectively.


Must Have

  • Managing production-critical systems with deep knowledge of SRE and DevOps principles .
  • Proven experience mentoring engineers and leading technical projects.
  • Strong proficiency with AWS and cloud-native best practices.
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes (EKS or GKE) and large-scale container orchestration.
  • Expertise with Terraform for infrastructure provisioning.
  • Experience managing and debugging Redis and Postgres databases.
  • Solid understanding of VPCs, VPNs, load balancers, and cloud networking .
  • Proficiency with Git , branching strategies, and CI/CD integrations.
  • Strong grasp of web and network protocols (HTTP, REST, TLS, DNS, etc.).


Nice to Have

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • Experience breaking down large, ambiguous projects into actionable tasks.
  • Familiarity with ArgoCD , GitHub Actions , Jenkins , or similar CI/CD tools.
  • Working knowledge of Python , Golang , and Helm .
  • Experience running scalable Node.js microservices.
  • Knowledge of cloud infrastructure security and Terragrunt best practices.
  • Background in production readiness and high-growth engineering environments .


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Cloud Data Engineer
description:
Employment type: Direct Hire – Full-time, with all benefits required by Brazil law

Salary range: Competitive and negotiable based on experience

Language: Bilingual (Advanced English – excellent verbal and written communication skills required)


The Senior Cloud Data Engineer leads the design, architecture, and implementation of secure, scalable data solutions on AWS, utilizing Snowflake, dbt, and modern automation tools. This role drives best practices for data quality, validation, and governance, while optimizing performance and reliability across both cloud and legacy platforms. The Senior Cloud Data Engineer collaborates closely with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into robust data pipelines and products, mentor junior engineers, and champions continuous improvement in engineering standards and operational excellence.


Key Responsibilities

  • Leads the design, development, and maintenance of highly scalable, secure, and resilient data pipelines and systems on cloud platforms.
  • Architects and implements advanced data integration solutions to support complex analytics, business intelligence, and enterprise reporting needs.
  • Collaborates with cross-functional teams, including data scientists, business analysts, product owners, and application engineers—to understand and deliver on evolving data requirements.
  • Ensures the highest standards of data quality, integrity, and security through comprehensive testing, validation, and robust governance practices.
  • Monitors, optimizes, and scales data workflows to achieve performance, reliability, and cost-efficiency targets across both cloud and legacy environments.
  • Proactively identifies, investigates, and resolves data-related issues, providing technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to junior team members.
  • Champions continuous improvement by staying current with industry trends, emerging technologies, best practices, and by driving innovation in data engineering processes and solutions.
  • Partners with enterprise architecture and data governance teams to define and enforce data standards and compliance requirements.
  • Leads design reviews and technical workshops to uplevel engineering practices across the organization.
  • Contributes to strategic planning for data platform evolution and modernization initiatives.



Requirements

  • Minimum of 7 years of progressive experience in data engineering, with a strong emphasis on designing and implementing cloud-based solutions.
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL , with hands-on experience in both relational (e.g., Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, Snowflake) and NoSQL (e.g., MongoDB, DynamoDB) databases.
  • Extensive experience architecting and operating data platforms on AWS and Azure; relevant cloud certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Data Analytics, Azure Data Engineer Associate) strongly preferred.
  • Deep knowledge of data warehousing concepts, ETL/ELT processes, data modeling , and enterprise data governance frameworks.
  • Demonstrated success in leading and mentoring data engineering teams, driving technical excellence and fostering collaborative environments.
  • Exceptional problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently and proactively in fast-paced settings.
  • English level: B2 (upper-intermediate) .


Benefits

  • Career development plan and continuous learning.
  • Excellent work environment and flexibility.
  • Meal Allowance R$ 50.00 per day
  • Life Insurance
  • Health Insurance (Sul America)
  • Transportation Allowance
  • Appreciation Bonus


If you’re looking for a place where professional growth goes hand in hand with quality of life, this opportunity is for you!

title: Manager, Corporate Development

Manager, Corporate Development


Easy Payroll Global Limited Ireland and their local affiliate ITOS Brasil LTDA is looking to hire a Manager, Corporate Development, to provide services to companies within the Perseus Group (“Perseus”).

Location: Brazil


The Role:

The services to be provided by the Manager, Corporate Development, encompasses building strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. These relationships will be formed with software company decision makers (e.g. CEOs, VPs of Corporate Development, founders, and/or owners) of software companies, M&A advisors, and private equity/ venture capital professionals. Success in this role is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships that ultimately lead to Perseus’ acquisition of software companies.


The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/ relationships, and high-quality market research are what ultimately generate successful acquisitions through time.

Perseus is an Operating Group of Constellation Software Inc. (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, and located in over 40 offices.


Location: Brazil


The Role:

The services to be provided by the Manager, Corporate Development, encompasses building strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. These relationships will be formed with software company decision makers (e.g. CEOs, VPs of Corporate Development, founders, and/or owners) of software companies, M&A advisors, and private equity/ venture capital professionals. Success in this role is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships that ultimately lead to Perseus’ acquisition of software companies.


The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/ relationships, and high-quality market research are what ultimately generate successful acquisitions through time.

  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.

title: Inside Sales (Vendedor Interno)
description:
Prazer, somos a Tripla.


Uma empresa brasileira de tecnologia que protege e impulsiona negócios — esse é o nosso propósito. Atuamos nacionalmente com soluções especializadas em infraestrutura, cibersegurança, continuidade de negócios e governança & compliance.


Trabalhamos para remover as barreiras tecnológicas que impedem o crescimento sustentável das empresas.


Com nossas soluções, ajudamos a manter a operação disponível, protegida e em conformidade — permitindo que você economize recursos e tenha mais tempo para investir na estratégia do seu negócio.


Com mais de 500 organizações atendidas e parcerias com os principais players do mercado, cocriamos um futuro mais eficiente, resiliente e escalável para nossos clientes.


E o nosso diferencial? Acreditamos que pessoas incríveis constroem resultados incríveis. Aqui, cada Tripulante é parte essencial da nossa jornada!


Estamos em busca de um(a) Vendedor Interno para atuar com vendas em soluções de Tecnologia.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:


Buscamos um profissional que será responsável por atender leads de base e novos, qualificando e apresentando soluções tecnológicas de forma consultiva e conduzindo todo o ciclo de vendas de maneira remota. Atuar na geração de novos negócios e na construção de um relacionamento sólido com os clientes, contribuindo para o crescimento sustentável da empresa e o atingimento das metas comerciais.


1. Identificar e conduzir oportunidades de vendas na área de tecnologia da informação por meio de abordagens remotas visando a geração de novos negócios e o alcance das metas de vendas da empresa.

2. Qualificar leads para garantir que atendam aos critérios de encaixe com as soluções da empresa.

3. Estabelecer contato inicial com prospects e clientes potenciais, visando a busca de novas oportunidades de negócio.

4. Realizar apresentações de produtos e serviços de tecnologia aos clientes visando geração de novos negócios para a empresa.

5. Identificar e entender as necessidades dos clientes visando propor soluções e projetos personalizados e inovadores para o atendimento de suas demandas de forma assertiva visando a continuidade ou criação de novas oportunidades de negócios.

6. Colaborar com a equipe técnica sempre que demandado auxiliando no desenvolvimento de soluções personalizadas para os clientes da carteira sob sua responsabilidade visando o atendimento de demandas identificadas.

7. Manter registros precisos das interações com os clientes no sistema de gerenciamento de vendas. Visando o controle efetivo das oportunidades de vendas prospectadas.


8. Buscar manter-se atualizado sobre produtos e serviços de tecnologia para melhor atender aos clientes, bem como sobre as tendências do setor, concorrência e melhores práticas de abordagens vendas remotas, visando geração de novos negócios.

9. Construir e manter relacionamentos com os clientes da carteira sob sua responsabilidade visando a continuidade e/ou a possibilidades de novos negócios.


Requisitos e qualificações:


-Conhecimento básico em produtos e serviços de TI.

-Experiência em vendas consultivas, preferencialmente em tecnologia da informação.

- Capacidade de ouvir atentamente e entender as necessidades dos clientes.

- Capacidade de análise.

- Ter conhecimento na aplicabilidade de metodologias de vendas - Spin Selling e BANT.

- Usar ferramenta de gestão de clientes CRM.


Informações adicionais:


  • Ajuda de custo de R$40,10 por dia útil.
  • Plano de saúde unimed (Unipart) 90% da mensalidade é custeada pela empresa e 10% pelo colaborador + a coparticipação.
  • Unimed odonto 100% custeado pela Tripla.
  • Gympass.
  • Allya.
  • Incentivo a Capacitação em curso e certificação.
  • Day off no aniversário.
  • PPR.
  • VT ou Auxílio Mobilidade.

title: Coordenação de Eficiência Energética
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.


Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.


A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Definir política, metas, baseline e governança de eficiência energética, alinhado à ISO 50001.
  • Gerir portfólio de projetos de eficiência, incluindo bombeamento, VFDs, reengenharia hidráulica e qualidade de energia.
  • Estabelecer e monitorar KPIs energéticos e financeiros (kWh/m³, R$/m³, demanda contratada vs. medida, FP, custo evitado).
  • Implantar planos de medição e verificação (IPMVP), garantindo savings auditáveis com ajustes de baseline e sazonalidade.
  • Priorizar CAPEX/OPEX com business cases (TIR, VPL, payback) e conduzir TRs, RFPs e contratos de performance.
  • Integrar dados de medição e padronizar cadastros e repositórios energéticos.
  • Liderar equipe técnica e engajar áreas multifuncionais, reportando resultados a fóruns executivos e auditorias.


Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia Elétrica ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência consolidada em eficiência energética ou gestão de energia.
  • Vivência prática em liderança de equipes e gestão de pessoas.
  • Domínio técnico em sistemas de bombeamento, motores, acionamentos (VFDs), fator de potência e qualidade de energia.
  • Conhecimento em tarifação, contratos de energia e medições com analisadores.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias de Medição e Verificação (IPMVP).
  • Excel avançado.


Requisitos Desejáveis

  • Certificações: CEM, CMVP, ISO 50001, PMP ou metodologias ágeis.
  • Conhecimento em Power BI e/ou SQL.


Benefícios

  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);
  • Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Gympass;
  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • Kit office.


Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!


A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +800 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 33 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.


Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 21.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

title: Coordenação de Eficiência Energética
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.


Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.


A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Definir política, metas, baseline e governança de eficiência energética, alinhado à ISO 50001.
  • Gerir portfólio de projetos de eficiência, incluindo bombeamento, VFDs, reengenharia hidráulica e qualidade de energia.
  • Estabelecer e monitorar KPIs energéticos e financeiros (kWh/m³, R$/m³, demanda contratada vs. medida, FP, custo evitado).
  • Implantar planos de medição e verificação (IPMVP), garantindo savings auditáveis com ajustes de baseline e sazonalidade.
  • Priorizar CAPEX/OPEX com business cases (TIR, VPL, payback) e conduzir TRs, RFPs e contratos de performance.
  • Integrar dados de medição e padronizar cadastros e repositórios energéticos.
  • Liderar equipe técnica e engajar áreas multifuncionais, reportando resultados a fóruns executivos e auditorias.


Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia Elétrica ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência consolidada em eficiência energética ou gestão de energia.
  • Vivência prática em liderança de equipes e gestão de pessoas.
  • Domínio técnico em sistemas de bombeamento, motores, acionamentos (VFDs), fator de potência e qualidade de energia.
  • Conhecimento em tarifação, contratos de energia e medições com analisadores.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias de Medição e Verificação (IPMVP).
  • Excel avançado.


Requisitos Desejáveis

  • Certificações: CEM, CMVP, ISO 50001, PMP ou metodologias ágeis.
  • Conhecimento em Power BI e/ou SQL.


Benefícios

  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);
  • Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Gympass;
  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • Kit office.


Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!


A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +800 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 33 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.


Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 21.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

title: Desenvolvedor Backed Go
description:
Na GrooveTech somos referência em inovação e excelência técnica no universo da tecnologia da informação. Atuamos com serviços de ITO (Information Technology Outsourcing), NOC 24x7 e Projetos Consultivos, sendo parceiros estratégicos de grandes empresas no Brasil.

Combinamos inteligência, tecnologia e foco em entregar soluções completas, eficientes e que geram impacto real nos negócios. Somos o seu time de tecnologia!


Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Back-end Sênior para atuar em projetos desafiadores, com foco em arquiteturas modernas, alta disponibilidade e escalabilidade. Se você gosta de resolver problemas complexos e construir soluções robustas do zero, essa oportunidade é pra você!


O que você vai fazer

Desenvolver produtos de ponta a ponta do planejamento à sustentação.

Projetar e implementar microsserviços e sistemas distribuídos de alta performance.

Colaborar com times multidisciplinares (Produto, Design, QA e Engenharia).

Atuar como referência técnica, conduzindo code reviews e boas práticas.

Garantir qualidade, segurança e observabilidade nas entregas.


Requisitos

+5 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento back-end.

Proficiência em Go (Golang) e experiência com aplicações em produção.

Conhecimento em bancos relacionais e NoSQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, MongoDB).

Vivência com clouds (AWS, GCP ou Azure), Docker e Kubernetes.

Experiência com Node.js.

Boa comunicação e colaboração em times ágeis.


Diferenciais que vão te destacar:

Vivência com Kafka, RabbitMQ, APIs RESTful e GraphQL.

Conhecimento em CI/CD, observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry) e Infra como Código (Terraform).

Boas práticas de segurança (OAuth2, JWT) e design de sistemas escaláveis.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Company Description

We are…

A digital sports media group with an innovative approach and fan-first mentality, we're redefining how sports content is consumed and shared.

Like all winning teams, we value respect, creativity, and fun. We operate in a dynamic environment where collaboration drives ideation and where you will help shape the ever-growing sports media landscape as we know it. Here at EMP, we provide an opportunity for your voice to be heard and create a space where you can have fun in the process. We’re not just about work, rather we look to build a community that celebrates victories, learns from hardships, and grows as one. Whether you are a sports fan or just curious, EMP is the place where your talent can shine while you make a real impact along the way.

You Are...

An experienced and driven graphic design professional with experience producing quality video edits, ideally within the media, entertainment, or sports industry. You are passionate about growth, entrepreneurial in spirit, and able to work in collaboration with a team

﻿

Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for a Graphic Designer. The Graphic Designer will be responsible for creating visual content including graphics, logos, branding materials, and typography designs. You will collaborate with the marketing team to develop and implement creative concepts and ensure brand consistency across all platforms. Daily tasks will include brainstorming ideas, executing design projects, and refining designs based on feedback.


Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Graphic Design and Graphics
  • Experience in Logo Design and Branding
  • Skills in Typography
  • Strong attention to detail and creativity
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Ability to work independently and remotely
  • Proficiency with design software such as Adobe Creative Suite
  • Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or related field
  • Experience in digital media or marketing is a plus
  • Proficiency in English, spoken and written.

title: Médico Endocrinologista (RQE)
description:
*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ENDOCRINOLOGISTA (com RQE) NA TELADOC HEALTH"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em Endocrinologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *


A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;

title: Financial Analyst, Acquisitions
description:
Company

Homestead Communities (the “Company”) addresses the affordable housing crisis in the United States by providing safe, clean and supportive communities where working families and retirees can own or rent affordable, high-quality, single-family manufactured homes.  Founded in 2023, the Company was one of the ten largest buyers of manufactured housing communities (“MHC”) over the past two years. Homestead Communities is committed to responsible stewardship for its residents, providing engaging careers for its team members, and delivering attractive risk-adjusted returns to its investor. 

Homestead Communities is owned by its management team and one of the world’s largest, publicly-traded, international real estate investors. The Company combines proven, growth-orientated entrepreneurial leadership with institutional discipline and financial capability. This position offers the opportunity to contribute meaningfully to a new enterprise with proven partners and the resources and experience to build a significant operating business.

Location

Anywhere in Brasil, (or Latin America).  The position is home-based.


Position Overview

The Financial Analyst, Acquisitions will use the Company’s financial model to project cash flows for potential acquisitions. Projections include initial capital, financing, and monthly operating income and expenses. Projections depend on analysis of MHC’s historic financial statements, current rent roll, and primary market research, all lead by the Financial Analyst, Acquisitions.  Further financial analysis, which may require additional market or property diligence, is typically needed to respond to property-specific questions and unique investment characteristics.

The position can be full-time or a minimum commitment of 25 hours weekly. If part-time, the candidate must have flexibility to meet carrying deadlines for workflow. The daily time commitment will vary with the Company’s deal flow. There will be times when there are multiple transactions at the same time and times when there are short deadlines.  There will be times between transactions that the Financial Analyst, Acquisitions will assist in broader work related to acquisitions.

Responsibilities

·        Prepare cash flow projections for proposed acquisitions.

o   Detailed, monthly projections for ten-year hold period. Dozens of line-items used to specify assumptions and clearly calculate resulting values.

title: Senior Web Designer
description:
We’re looking for an experienced and creative Web Designer to join our fully remote team to work on a variety of projects for our clients across the globe.


Overview


Wunderdogs is an independent creative agency based in San Francisco, California with a growing distributed team across the U.S., Canada and Europe. We provide beginning-to-end design, production and strategy services to forward-thinking brands in the technology space, from startups to established companies.

From one-off-digital projects to full website designs, no two Wunderdogs jobs are the same: if you’re a creative who enjoys variety in what you do the diverse nature of our work is sure to keep you on your toes. We’re looking for a designer excited by the opportunity to support our team on our digital creative and elevate our work to the next level.


Websites form a core part of our business therefore a passion for and extensive experience in web design is a must. Our ideal candidate will have a strong visual sense, an analytical mind, a good eye for detail and the portfolio to back it up.


We’re looking for someone who does not shy away from a challenge and is comfortable working to tight deadlines when required. You will be joining us during an exciting time and will be working on multiple projects simultaneously, often for different clients. Our team is entrepreneurial, smart, hard working and fun - Wunderdogs is a challenging yet very rewarding workplace, one where your effort and passion can make a real difference to our clients.


Your key day-to-day responsibilities will include


  • Conceptualizing creative ideas with clients
  • Testing and improving the design of the website
  • Establishing design guidelines, standards, and best practices
  • Maintaining the appearance of websites by enforcing content standards
  • Designing visual imagery for websites and ensuring that they are in line with branding for clients.
  • Effectively communicate your designs to developers and other key stakeholders
  • Address product, marketing and business needs
  • Conduct industry research and stay up-to-date on best practices, competitor UI designs and emerging technologies
  • Facilitate web workshops for our clients
  • Create lo-fi wireframes and high-fidelity designs in Figma
  • Develop design systems, design websites using brand guidelines
  • Communicate with clients and attend client meetings
  • Collaborate with developers to design new and intuitive user experiences
  • Interact with our development and management teams to collaborate on pitches and strategies


The Qualifications


  • 4-5 years of design industry experience
  • Bachelor’s degree in graphic design or similar field and a strong portfolio of digital projects
  • Fluent across the Adobe Creative Suite and Figma
  • Understanding of design systems and how to create them
  • Understanding of Figma and how to use it
  • Great communication skills: whether it’s talking through your work with the team or speaking with clients, you’ll need to be able to get your point across and empathize with those of others
  • Experience creating products with complex user flows and high-quality UI design is a plus
  • Experience running stakeholder workshops with clients
  • Ability to work at least 3-4 business hours in Pacific Standard Time
  • Self-motivation in a remote professional environment and ability to work independently as well as part of a team
  • Sharp attention to detail within a fast-paced work environment


The Perks


  • Diverse team and interesting projects from all over the globe
  • KPI-based yearly bonus
  • Fully remote job (traveling is encouraged)
  • Highly cooperative team that encourages professional growth and self-development
  • Salary is commensurate with experience


How to apply


To be considered, send your cover letter, CV, case studies, portfolio, references and any supporting materials to

title: Analista de dados sênior
description:
Sobre a Banana Games

A Banana Games  é uma provedora de conteúdo para o mercado de iGaming , criadora de alguns dos jogos online mais envolventes e inovadores da atualidade.

Desenvolvemos experiências de alto desempenho e operamos com escala global. Agora, buscamos elevar nossa visão de negócio com inteligência de dados  — e você pode ser parte dessa construção.

Sobre o Desafio

Procuramos um(a) Analista de Dados Sênior  que transforme milhões de linhas de dados de sessão, transações e engajamento em insights estratégicos , dashboards  e indicadores-chave de sucesso .

Você será peça-chave para ajudar a empresa a entender o comportamento dos jogadores , medir a aceitação de cada jogo  e guiar decisões de produto e monetização com base em dados.

Responsabilidades
  • Estruturar e modelar dados de sessões, apostas, rodadas e usuários.
  • Criar painéis dinâmicos (BI)  que mostrem métricas como engajamento, retenção, churn, RTP, GGR e comportamento por jogo.
  • Trabalhar junto ao time de tecnologia e produto para definir eventos e KPIs  de jogo.
  • Gerar relatórios e análises que apoiem decisões de roadmap e priorização.
  • Automatizar processos de coleta, transformação e visualização de dados.
  • Garantir a qualidade, consistência e integridade dos dados.
Requisitos
  • Experiência sólida em análise de dados e BI , de preferência no mercado digital ou de jogos.
  • Domínio em SQL  e ferramentas de visualização (Power BI, Tableau, Metabase, Looker, etc.) .
  • Experiência com ETL / ELT  e manipulação de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Conhecimento em Python (pandas, numpy)  ou R  para análise avançada.
  • Capacidade de traduzir dados técnicos em narrativas de negócio .
  • Perfil analítico, investigativo e orientado a resultados.

  • Experiência com ETL / ELT  e manipulação de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Conhecimento em Python (pandas, numpy)  ou R  para análise avançada.
  • Capacidade de traduzir dados técnicos em narrativas de negócio .
  • Perfil analítico, investigativo e orientado a resultados.

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.
