title: Tech Lead
description:
Somos a Vortigo - nascemos com o propósito de criar aplicativos mobile para um mundo em constante movimento, mas não paramos por aí. Ampliamos nossa atuação e hoje desenvolvemos softwares para ajudar empresas e startups no processo de transformação digital.

Nosso time é composto por pessoas apaixonadas por desafios gigantes, mudando a experiência dos usuários a nível global.

Estamos espalhados pelo Brasil e pelo mundo, tocando projetos nacionais e internacionais.

Nosso ambiente é descontraído, com uma cultura horizontal, muita troca de conhecimento, reconhecimento e desafios! Tá afim de fazer parte de tudo isso?

Dá uma olhada no que estamos buscando:


Atribuições:

- Definir e propor soluções técnicas alinhadas aos desafios do negócio, liderando o desenho da arquitetura com foco em performance, segurança e escalabilidade.

- Organizar e acompanhar as atividades do time de desenvolvimento, promovendo alinhamento técnico e fluidez na entrega de valor.

- Supervisionar a implementação das soluções, assegurando aderência aos padrões de qualidade, boas práticas de engenharia e governança de código.

- Promover o uso de boas práticas como testes automatizados, code review, integração continua, documentação técnica e segurança desde o desenvolvimento.

- Atuar com mentoria técnica, contribuindo para o crescimento da equipe por meio de orientação, feedbacks e compartilhamento de conhecimento.

- Ser o elo técnico entre o time de desenvolvimento e áreas parceiras como Produto, Segurança, Infraestrutura e demais squads.


Habilidades Técnicas:

- .NET Core / C# – domínio da linguagem e do framework para construção de APIs e aplicações backend.

- Mensageria – conhecimento prático em RabbitMQ e Apache Kakfa .

- Cache e performance – uso de Redis para otimização de consultas e redução de latência.

- Bancos de dados relacionais – domínio em SQL Server , incluindo modelagem, tunning de queries e boas práticas de banco de dados.

- Experiência prévia como Tech Lead ou referência técnica em squads ágeis.

- Vivência em ambientes com esteiras de CI/CD , testes automatizados e pipelines de deploy.

- Experiência com times que atuam no ecossistema de meios de pagamento .

- Boa comunicação , com habilidade para traduzir temas técnicos complexos em linguagem acessível para áreas não técnicas.


O que você encontra aqui:

Remote First – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar.

Comunidades Técnicas – Um espaço para galera trocar uma ideia, conversar sobre algum assunto específico e, claro, muita troca de conhecimentos.

Cultura de Feedback – Feedbacks estruturados periodicamente, buscando o desenvolvimento contínuo através de um Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI).

Horário Flexível - Autonomia para fazer a sua própria gestão da jornada de trabalho.

Incentivo ao Idioma - Temos como objetivo internacionalizar cada vez mais a Vortigo e você será parte disso!

Wellhub - Plataforma focada na saúde e bem-estar corporativo.

Reembolso de Equipamentos – Valor semestral de reembolso para compra de equipamentos que facilitam sua rotina de trabalho em casa.

- Atuar com mentoria técnica, contribuindo para o crescimento da equipe por meio de orientação, feedbacks e compartilhamento de conhecimento.

- Ser o elo técnico entre o time de desenvolvimento e áreas parceiras como Produto, Segurança, Infraestrutura e demais squads.


Habilidades Técnicas:

- .NET Core / C# – domínio da linguagem e do framework para construção de APIs e aplicações backend.

- Mensageria – conhecimento prático em RabbitMQ e Apache Kakfa .

- Cache e performance – uso de Redis para otimização de consultas e redução de latência.

- Bancos de dados relacionais – domínio em SQL Server , incluindo modelagem, tunning de queries e boas práticas de banco de dados.

- Experiência prévia como Tech Lead ou referência técnica em squads ágeis.

- Vivência em ambientes com esteiras de CI/CD , testes automatizados e pipelines de deploy.

- Experiência com times que atuam no ecossistema de meios de pagamento .

- Boa comunicação , com habilidade para traduzir temas técnicos complexos em linguagem acessível para áreas não técnicas.


O que você encontra aqui:

Remote First – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar.

Comunidades Técnicas – Um espaço para galera trocar uma ideia, conversar sobre algum assunto específico e, claro, muita troca de conhecimentos.

Cultura de Feedback – Feedbacks estruturados periodicamente, buscando o desenvolvimento contínuo através de um Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI).

Horário Flexível - Autonomia para fazer a sua própria gestão da jornada de trabalho.

Incentivo ao Idioma - Temos como objetivo internacionalizar cada vez mais a Vortigo e você será parte disso!

Wellhub - Plataforma focada na saúde e bem-estar corporativo.

Reembolso de Equipamentos – Valor semestral de reembolso para compra de equipamentos que facilitam sua rotina de trabalho em casa.

title: Gerente de PLD
description:
Sobre nós


A Kiwify é uma das maiores plataformas de infoprodutos do Brasil, possibilitando que qualquer pessoa crie e venda seus cursos online.


Somos acelerados pela Y Combinator, do Vale do Silício, e hoje já impactamos milhões de usuários.


Agora estamos dando o próximo passo e criando a Conta Digital da Kiwify, que já nasce com alcance massivo e um canal único de distribuição através dos maiores influenciadores do país.


Acreditamos que a Kiwify se tornará uma das maiores contas digitais do Brasil, e queremos pessoas excepcionais para construir essa história com a gente.



Modelo


  • Remoto



Período


  • Segunda à sexta, das 09h às 18h00 (1h de intervalo)



Benefícios


  • VR/VA – R$ 1.000,00 (Flash Benefícios)
  • Plano de Saúde
  • Plano Odontológico
  • WellHub – Gympass



Responsabilidades


  • Liderar o time de PLD e Compliance, garantindo processos robustos de prevenção à lavagem de dinheiro, prevenção a fraudes e financiamento ao terrorismo.


  • Desenvolver políticas, normas e procedimentos alinhados às regulamentações do Banco Central e melhores práticas de mercado.


  • Implementar e aprimorar sistemas de monitoramento de transações suspeitas, alertas e relatórios regulatórios.


  • Conduzir investigações internas e análises de clientes, colaboradores, fornecedores e parceiros (KYC, KYE, KYP e Due Diligence).


  • Assegurar a entrega tempestiva e correta de reportes obrigatórios (COAF, Bacen, entre outros).


  • Trabalhar lado a lado com áreas de Risco, Operações e Jurídico para mitigar riscos regulatórios e reputacionais.


  • Fomentar uma cultura de conformidade dentro da empresa, com treinamentos recorrentes e comunicação clara.



Requisitos


  • Pelo menos 3 anos de experiência em posição de liderança em PLD/Compliance em fintechs, bancos ou instituições financeiras.


  • Experiência em desenvolver e implementar políticas, normas e procedimentos de PLD alinhados às exigências regulatórias e melhores práticas internacionais.


  • Conhecimento sólido das regulamentações brasileiras (BACEN, COAF, CVM, SUSEP) e normas internacionais (FATF, OFAC, AMLD).


  • Experiência comprovada em liderar times de PLD, contratar, treinar e desligar profissionais da área.


  • Capacidade de estruturar processos e times de PLD em empresas em rápido crescimento.


  • Forte senso de urgência, responsabilidade e mentalidade hands-on.


  • Comunicação clara, objetiva e com alta capacidade de alinhamento interdepartamental.

title: PHP Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for PHP Senior Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Able to work independently with minimal supervision, as well as collaborate with a diverse team.

- Accountable for resolution of the most technically challenging issues facing the organization.

- Write code with increasing quality and maintainability.

- Guide the architecture of large features which impact all parts of the company, identifying issues and raising concerns/blockers for mitigation.

- Research and introduce new technology to improve the applications and/or the development pipeline.


Requirements:


- 5+ years of experience working with PHP with strong Front-End skills.

- Workflow Management, design and implementation in all its stages.

- Collaboration with the development team in the achievement of technical challenges, code upgrades, working closely with architects, developers, business analysts, testers and product owners.

- Contribution to the preparation of technical documentation.

- Knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript and other frameworks such as, among others, Angular and React.

- Experience with frameworks such as Zend, Laravel, Symphony is desirable.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Desenvolvedor Android
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!


Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Sobre o Cargo: Desenvolvedor Android


Responsabilidades:



Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Android para atuar no desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades e manutenção de módulos existentes em nossos aplicativos.

O profissional terá foco inicial em implementar novas features com integrações backend via REST , trabalhando em colaboração com outros desenvolvedores de diferentes camadas da aplicação, sempre com o objetivo de gerar sinergia, qualidade e inovação .

Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver novas funcionalidades em aplicativos Android.
  • Manter e evoluir módulos já existentes.
  • Integrar aplicações com serviços backend via REST.
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares em um ambiente ágil.
  • Garantir qualidade do código por meio de boas práticas e testes automatizados.

Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência em metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban) .
  • Domínio em Java e Kotlin .
  • Conhecimento em Gradle .
  • Aplicação de princípios SOLID .
  • Experiência em Design Patterns (MVVM, Clean Architecture) .
  • Criação de testes unitários .
  • Controle de versão com GIT (Gitflow, GitLab) .

title: Java Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Java Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Work with software development teams to gather requirements and ensure best practices are adhered.

- Design, Implement & Support solutions for application development, security, analytics and performance management.

- Conform to existing industry security coding standards adhering to fortify scan and other security tool review requirements.

- Conduct code reviews for junior members of the team and do peer code reviews to make sure code is following standards set forward by the architects.

- Run test scripts against code to ensure quality delivery.

- Resolve code issues with urgency.


Requirements:


- 5+ years of experience in Java.

- Experience in web application programming.

- Knowledge of Object Oriented Programming.

- Ability to work with relational and non-relational bases.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Senior Full Stack Developer, Healthcare and Factory Automation
description:
We are a US startup company headquartered in New York City (


We deliver innovative applications and data solutions to consumers and enterprises. Our projects typically include social, financial, gaming, and shopping elements.


We are looking for highly talented, motivated, and responsible engineers. We value people who are able to understand business needs and solve difficult problems, as well as people who are willing to learn new things and take responsibility for delivering great results.


We provide an exciting environment with others who share a passion for excellence. Come meet us and see for yourself if you want to join a growing international business.


Position: Senior Full Stack Developer, Healthcare and Factory Automation


Work on the next generation of healthcare and factory automation applications and services powered by AI and excellent experiences. Join a team of experienced startup developers building out highly scalable service architectures to radically change the status quo in healthcare and factory automation.


Desirable technology experience:

● Python / Go

● gRPC / Protocol Buffers

● React.js / React Native / Vue

● PostgreSQL / SQL Server

● AWS serverless technologies: Lambda, SQS, SNS, etc.

● Applications of LLM and ML AI technologies


Desirable subject matter expertise:

Healthcare and factory automation. Experience with other insurance markets. Fintech, particularly trading and portfolio applications for financial advisors and their investors.


Minimum Applicant Requirements:

● Excellent command of English, written and spoken

● Ability to produce tested applications from business requirements

● Ability to work independently and as a team member

● Self-starting, well-organized, and enthusiastic work style

● At least 8+ years of working experience in relevant technologies


Additional requirements:

This position requires a background check of your work and life experience by a 3rd party.


Benefits:

● Competitive compensation

● Flexible work/life balance

● Work with the latest technologies

● Work with a small, intense, and fun team


Applicant Questions

SUBMISSIONS WITHOUT ANSWERS TO THESE QUESTIONS WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED:

If you are interested in the position, please compose a written introduction to yourself in the English language, including answers to the questions below, as well as anything else we should know, and send it along with your resume.


  • When can you start?
  • How many years have you worked full-time as a Full Stack Developer?
  • What hourly rate do you charge for full-time contract jobs?
  • Please write a paragraph about your favorite past project. Be sure to tell us why you liked it.


Due to the number of applications from fake identities, you will be required to present an ID (Passport or Driver’s License) sufficient to verify your identity at the beginning of your first interview.

title: Consultor Basis
description:
Consultor SAP Basis Sênior

Data de Início: Imediata

Tempo de Alocação: Indeterminado

Local de Trabalho: 100% remoto

Horário de Trabalho: UK Time (10 AM – 19 PM)


Responsabilidades e atribuições

• Administrar e gerenciar o ambiente SAP, incluindo instalação, configuração, monitoramento e manutenção de sistemas SAP (ECC, S/4HANA, BW, PI/PO, etc.).

• Realizar atualizações, migrações e patches em sistemas SAP.

• Gerenciar a configuração e administração de usuários, segurança, perfis e autorizações.

• Planejar e executar tarefas de backup, recuperação de desastres e garantir a continuidade dos negócios.

• Realizar monitoramento de desempenho, análise e ajuste fino dos sistemas SAP.

• Colaborar com equipes de projeto para implementar soluções SAP em ambientes de desenvolvimento, teste e produção.

• Suporte a auditorias de segurança e conformidade, garantindo que as práticas recomendadas sejam seguidas.

• Prover suporte técnico de alta qualidade para a equipe interna e stakeholders.

• Documentar procedimentos e melhores práticas para a operação e administração dos sistemas SAP.


Requisitos e qualificações

• Experiência mínima de 10 anos como Consultor SAP Basis, com histórico comprovado em ambientes complexos.

• Proficiência em instalação, atualização e administração de diferentes componentes do SAP (ABAP, JAVA, NetWeaver, HANA, etc.).

• Suporte e administração de bases de dados SAP HANA, Oracle, DB2, SQL Server, Sybase ASE, incluindo a execução de tuning de performance e troubleshooting.

• Configuração e gerenciamento de clusters de alta disponibilidade e soluções de failover em ambientes SAP.

• Experiência com SAP Solution Manager.

• Experiência em administração de ambientes SAP em cloud, como AWS, Azure, ou Google Cloud Platform.

• Familiaridade com sistemas operacionais, como Linux, Windows e UNIX.

• Habilidades em resolução de problemas e capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão.

• Certificação SAP Basis e/ou SAP HANA será um diferencial.

• Inglês fluente, tanto escrito quanto falado.

• Capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente e em equipe.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e organização.

• Orientado a detalhes com forte habilidade analítica.


Maiores detalhes serão fornecidos durante entrevista técnica com o cliente.

title: Especialista SAP ABAP e FIORI
description:
Who we are

At Amaris Consulting , we are an independent technology consulting firm providing guidance and solutions to businesses. We partner with more than 1,000 clients worldwide, delivering expertise across multiple sectors to drive digital transformation and innovation.

In Brazil , Amaris has grown year after year, reaching over 400 projects and collaborating with international clients from the US and Europe . Our consultants benefit from career development, ongoing training , and the flexibility to be reallocated across projects , ensuring exposure to diverse technologies and challenges.

We stand out for how we care about our people — through regular follow-ups, human-centered management, and a strong focus on professional growth.


Job description

We are looking for a SAP ABAP Developer to join our remote team and support international projects. The ideal candidate will have strong technical experience in SAP development tools and the ability to communicate fluently in English while collaborating with global teams.


Your missions

  • Develop, maintain, and enhance SAP applications using ABAP.
  • Design and implement solutions using: Fiori, IDOCs, APIs, SmartForms , SAPscript , and Adobe Forms
  • Build and optimize Reports , Dynamic Developments , Excel Creations , and ALV Reports .
  • Develop and maintain Methods and Classes in line with project standards.
  • Collaborate with functional teams to translate business requirements into efficient technical solutions.
  • Ensure high-quality code and performance through testing and documentation.


Your profile

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.
  • Proven experience as a SAP ABAP Developer .
  • Fluent English (mandatory) — written and spoken.
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to work independently in a remote setup.


Strong knowledge of:

  • Fiori , IDOCs , APIs , SmartForms , SAPscript , Adobe Forms , Reports , ALV , and OO ABAP .
  • Good understanding of SAP modules and integration processes.



What we offer

  • International exposure with clients in Europe and the US .
  • A human-centered culture focused on career growth and development.
  • Access to training programs and mentoring opportunities through Amaris Academy.
  • Flexibility to work remotely with a dynamic and multicultural team.

title: DevOps Engineer - AWS
description:
Job Title: DevOps Engineer (AWS Specialist)

Location: Remote (Must be based in Brazil)

Job Type: Full-Time, Permanent

Salary: $4000-6,000 per month (Depending on experience)


IF APPLYING, SEND CV IN ENGLISH


About the Role

We are seeking an experienced and motivated DevOps Engineer with strong expertise in Amazon Web Services (AWS) and a solid background in Windows-based infrastructure .

As a member of our global DevOps and infrastructure team, you will be involved in designing, building, and maintaining modern cloud platforms and automation pipelines that support our mission-critical systems.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain AWS infrastructure using Terraform and other Infrastructure as Code tools.
  • Support and manage Windows-based systems including Active Directory , domain configuration , and Entra ID .
  • Implement security controls, tools, and processes aligned with best practices in cloud and infrastructure security .
  • Provide support across Windows systems as required (Linux knowledge is a plus).
  • Manage and scale containerized applications using Kubernetes .
  • Set up and manage monitoring and alerting with tools such as Prometheus and Grafana .
  • Collaborate with engineering, security, and operations teams to deliver reliable and secure infrastructure solutions.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipeline development and automation workflows.


Key Requirements

Must-Have Skills & Experience

  • Proven experience working with AWS in production environments.
  • Strong Windows Server experience, including Active Directory , domain setup , and Entra ID .
  • Working knowledge of infrastructure security best practices .
  • Practical experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code methodologies.
  • Experience with Kubernetes for container orchestration.
  • Expereince with Ansible
  • Familiarity with monitoring/observability using Grafana , Prometheus , or similar.
  • Fluent English communication skills .
  • Must be permanently based in Ireland and eligible to work without sponsorship.


Nice-to-Have

  • Experience with Linux system administration.
  • Exposure to CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI).
  • Scripting skills (e.g., PowerShell, Bash, Python).


What We Offer

  • Fully remote role , but you must reside in Brazil
  • Permanent employment with long-term project engagement and career progression.
  • Dynamic, international team working on cutting-edge cloud and DevOps technologies.
  • Opportunities for professional development and training.

title: Full Stack Engineer, Brazil
description:
About Optibus:

Optibus is a unified software platform revolutionizing public transportation planning, scheduling, and operations in over 7,000 cities worldwide. Using AI, ML, and optimization algorithms, it empowers agencies to design more efficient, equitable, and sustainable transit networks, enhancing passenger access, reducing emissions, and improving driver conditions. With offices globally and a team of 350+ employees, Optibus fosters a collaborative culture centered on innovation, determination, and impact. As the first unicorn in public transportation technology, Optibus is driving the modernization of mass transit to make it the preferred choice for cities and passengers alike.


About the position (role & team):

Optibus is looking for a talented Full Stack Engineer to join our Planning R&D team in the mission of making transportation smarter and more efficient. We're seeking a mid-level engineer with a strong software development background and experience building and maintaining modern web applications.

As a Full Stack Engineer on the Planning Team, you’ll contribute to the development of features and improvements for our mass transportation planning products, collaborating with other engineers, product managers, and designers to create high-quality, user-focused solutions.


Responsibilities :

  • Develop, deploy, and maintain full-stack applications using React, TypeScript in the frontend, and Node.js with TypeScript deployed on K8S in the backend
  • Actively participate in the entire development lifecycle, engaging in technical discussions
  • Collaborate with the Product Manager and Designer to deliver robust, scalable features.


Requirements:

  • 3+ years of full-stack web development
  • Experience with React client-side development
  • Experience with Node.js server-side development
  • Understanding of web application architecture
  • Familiarity with relational or NoSQL DBs (MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL)
  • B.Sc. or M.Sc. in computer science or a related field
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills


It would be great if you have:

  • Experience with Python
  • Experience with AWS or an alternative cloud environment
  • Experience in the mobility ecosystem
  • Experience with Agile methodologies and CI/CD processes


Optibus is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We hire talented individuals, regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, ancestry, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, cultural background, religious beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. It is our responsibility at Optibus to provide an inclusive and accessible interview experience for all. We will provide reasonable accommodations for all candidates in need of individualised support during the hiring process.

title: Data Architect
description:
About the Product:

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose:

The Data Architect will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining robust data models and SQL-based solutions, with a focus on Google Cloud Platform. This role will ensure data integrity, optimize database performance, and support data-driven initiatives, particularly within the higher education sector.


Duties and Responsibilities:

Data Modelling and SQL Development

  • Design and implement scalable and efficient relational and dimensional data models.
  • Develop, optimize, and maintain complex SQL queries, stored procedures, and functions.
  • Ensure data quality and integrity across various data sources and reporting layers.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand data requirements and translate them into technical specifications.


Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Expertise

  • Utilize GCP services such as BigQuery, Cloud SQL, and Dataflow for data storage, processing, and analysis.
  • Implement and manage cloud-based data warehouses and data lakes on GCP.
  • Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code solutions for GCP data environments using tools like Terraform.
  • Monitor and optimize GCP resource performance and cost for data platforms.


Collaboration and Communication

  • Serve as a primary liaison among business leads, product managers, and data/engineering teams.
  • Facilitate demos, knowledge-sharing sessions, and best-practice documentation for data solutions.
  • Promote adoption of new data capabilities and practices; gather feedback for continuous improvement.


Release and Change Management

  • Coordinate release plans, timelines, and stakeholder readiness for data model and SQL deployments.
  • Ensure training, job aids, and rollout communications are prepared and delivered for data solutions.
  • Track post-release issues, adoption, and stabilization metrics related to data platforms.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • Ability to produce and manage, work autonomously, and take initiative.
  • “Can-do” attitude with unwavering ethics and a willingness to help others.
  • Exceptional relationship-building skills, cultural competency, and ability to communicate effectively with diverse groups of people and roles.
  • Willingness to embrace relational nuances, own personal mistakes, be empathetic, address conflicts directly and transparently, and commit to self-reflection and self-betterment.
  • Dexterity to effectively deal with ambiguity, change, and continuous process improvements.
  • Strong business analysis fundamentals: elicitation, documentation, process mapping, traceability, UAT.


Requirements:

  • Strong proficiency in SQL and experience with relational database design and data modelling.
  • Demonstrable experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) data services (e.g., BigQuery, Cloud SQL, Dataflow).
  • Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code solutions, e.g., Terraform.
  • Experience with data quality checks and data governance best practices.
  • Experience with Git and Git providers, e.g., GitHub/BitBucket/GitLab.


Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience in the higher education space.
  • Experience with data orchestration frameworks, e.g., Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, dbt.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools for data platforms.
  • Familiarity with Python for data scripting and automation.


Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent life/work experience.
  • 5+ years in SQL engineering, data modelling, data engineering, or a related data-centric role, preferably within SaaS, marketing technology, higher ed tech, or related domains.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.

title: AI Full-Stack Engineer
description:
About the Product:

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose:

The AI Full-Stack Engineer will be responsible for building and maintaining AI applications on top of existing LLM APIs. This role will focus on integration, building robust AI-driven applications, and optimizing their evaluation and performance. The AI Full-Stack Engineer will ensure that our AI applications are developed, configured, and adopted to meet evolving needs, with a strong emphasis on Python-based solutions.


Duties and Responsibilities:

AI Application Development and Integration

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable and secure AI applications leveraging existing LLM APIs.
  • Implement and manage integrations with various AI platforms and services.
  • Develop and maintain Python-based applications, both cloud-deployed and on-premises, specifically tailored for AI functionalities.
  • Implement and manage CI/CD workflows for AI applications.
  • Monitor and optimize AI application performance and cost, including model evaluation and optimization.
  • Ensure data quality checks for AI models and applications; escalate defects with clear reproduction steps and impact.


Python Application Development

  • Utilize Python libraries and frameworks relevant to AI application development.
  • Collaborate with development teams to integrate AI applications with existing systems.


Collaboration and Communication

  • Serve as a primary conduit among business leads, product managers, and AI/engineering teams.
  • Facilitate demos, knowledge-sharing sessions, and best-practice documentation for AI development.
  • Promote adoption of new AI capabilities and practices; gather feedback for continuous improvement.


Release and Change Management

  • Coordinate release plans, timelines, and stakeholder readiness for AI application deployments.
  • Ensure training, job aids, and rollout communications are prepared and delivered for new AI features.
  • Track post-release issues, adoption, and stabilization metrics for AI applications.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • Ability to produce and manage, work autonomously, and take initiative.
  • “Can-do” attitude with unwavering ethics and a willingness to help others.
  • Exceptional relationship-building skills, cultural competency, and ability to communicate effectively with diverse groups of people and roles.
  • Willingness to embrace relational nuances, own personal mistakes, be empathetic, address conflicts directly and transparently, and commit to self-reflection and self-betterment.
  • Dexterity to effectively deal with ambiguity, change, and continuous process improvements.
  • Strong business analysis fundamentals: elicitation, documentation, process mapping, traceability, UAT.


Requirements:

  • Familiarity with existing LLM APIs and experience building applications on top of them.
  • Experience with integration of AI applications into existing systems.
  • Proficiency in Python and familiarity with AI-specific libraries and frameworks.
  • Experience with optimizing AI model evaluation and performance.
  • Cloud-based CI/CD workflows.
  • Experience with Git and Git providers, e.g., GitHub/BitBucket/GitLab.


Nice-to-haves:

  • Cloud-based IAM, networking, and security.
  • Experience with data orchestration frameworks, e.g., Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, dbt.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools for AI applications.


Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent life/work experience.
  • 2+ years in AI engineering, full-stack development with an AI focus, or related domains within SaaS, marketing technology, higher ed tech, or similar.
  • 6+ year in application development overall


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

title: Android Engineer
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


We are seeking a skilled Android Engineer to lead the development of innovative mobile applications with a focus on cross-platform initiatives using Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) and Jetpack Compose. Experience with iOS development is a strong plus, as you’ll help shape our cross-platform architecture and deliver products that seamlessly operate across Android and iOS ecosystems.


Key Responsibilities


  • Architect, develop, and maintain mobile applications leveraging KMP for shared business logic and Compose for modern UI design.
  • Collaborate on cross-platform initiatives, contributing to both Android and iOS codebases when necessary.
  • Analyze and optimize high-volume mobile systems for performance and scalability.
  • Refactor and revitalize codebases as technology evolves.
  • Lead development efforts for new products and enhancements to existing products in response to market changes.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve system failures, ensuring high-quality user experiences.
  • Work closely with other engineers, designers, and product managers to deliver innovative features.


Who You Are


  • 5+ years of experience in Android development with proficiency in Kotlin
  • Android Launcher experience is a strong plus
  • Hands-on experience with Jetpack Compose and modern Android architecture (MVVM, Clean Architecture).
  • Experience with Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) or other cross-platform frameworks.
  • Exposure to or experience with iOS development (Swift or Objective-C) is a strong plus.
  • Strong architecture design skills and ability to build reusable UI components.
  • Comfortable working on collaborative, fast-paced engineering teams.
  • Excellent communication, problem-solving, and time management skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
  • Self-starter with entrepreneurial drive and passion for innovation.

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
About Telepatia

Telepatia AI is building an AI Doctor to radically improve healthcare. We recently raised the largest LatAm seed round of $9M, backed by top global investors. Our team comes from Stanford, Microsoft, MD Anderson, Houston Methodist, and Alice, and we’re on a mission to transform how clinical data is captured and used.

Healthcare has two fundamental sources of truth: images and conversations. While most technology has focused on images, 99% of real medical decisions are made through voice. Telepatia is capturing that voice data and turning it into structured, reliable clinical intelligence—unlocking the foundation for an AI-first healthcare system.

We are assembling one of the most talent-dense technical teams in Latin America, with the ambition of building the “Manhattan Project” of AI in healthcare.


Mission of the Role

As an AI Engineer at Telepatia , your mission is to design, build, and deploy AI systems that turn unstructured clinical conversations into structured, reliable medical intelligence. You’ll work across the stack—from backend Python microservices and LLM orchestration to lightweight front-ends and data pipelines—integrating the latest in AI research into production workflows used by doctors daily.

You’ll be part of a small, elite team where each engineer’s output directly impacts the accuracy of our AI systems, the speed of our clinical documentation, and ultimately, patient care across Latin America. This is a role for builders who want to ship fast, work with autonomy, and push the boundaries of what’s possible in applied AI.


What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and scale Python microservices (FastAPI) that handle real-time inference and structured data processing.
  • Build AI agent pipelines for reasoning, orchestration, and multi-step workflows using tools like LangChain or CrewAI .
  • Develop data pipelines and eval dashboards to monitor, analyze, and improve AI model performance.
  • Collaborate closely with clinicians, product managers, and software engineers to turn ambiguous requests into production-ready AI features—often in less than a day.
  • Integrate models and pipelines into our core Medical Scribe product to enhance automation, reliability, and doctor experience.
  • Contribute to key technical decisions around LLM infrastructure, evaluation, scalability, and deployment.


Must-Haves

  • Strong backend experience in Python , with a focus on microservices (FastAPI preferred).
  • Experience building at the AI application layer : LLM orchestration, agents, and pipelines (LangChain, CrewAI, or similar).
  • Frontend familiarity with React/Tailwind or Flutter for rapid prototyping and data visualization.
  • Experience building and maintaining data pipelines and evaluation dashboards for AI models.
  • High product velocity: you prioritize shipping value quickly over theoretical perfection.
  • Ability to take ambiguous, non-technical requests and turn them into working production features in less than a day.
  • Strong ownership mindset, curiosity, and comfort working in a fast-paced, high-ambiguity environment.


Nice-to-Haves

  • Background in hard sciences such as Physics or Mathematics .
  • Experience with vector databases , RAG architectures , or model evaluation frameworks .
  • Prior work with healthcare data , EHR systems , or HIPAA/LGPD compliance.
  • Prior startup experience in high-growth or early-stage environments.

title: Developer Tools Fullstack Engineer
description:
About us:


Smarter Contact is the #1 messaging platform for real estate professionals in the U.S. Our SaaS product powers millions of conversations to close more deals through smart SMS, voice, and automation.


We’re a fast-growing SaaS with serious traction — and now we’re hiring an experienced Full Stack Engineer to build the internal systems, dev tools, and automation that keep our team moving fast and scaling smarter.


If you get excited about clean abstractions, developer productivity, and building tools that make everyone’s life better — we want to talk.



What You’ll Own:

  • Design and implement internal DevOps tools and automation systems
  • Build and maintain configuration management systems across multiple environments
  • Create simulation/mock environments for third-party API integrations
  • Develop and optimize Chrome extensions that improve internal workflows
  • Build internal reporting frameworks for operational and financial data
  • Create a layered permissions Admin Panel to reduce support load
  • Implement best-in-class monitoring, logging, and observability
  • Collaborate with developers, product, and ops to deliver tools that actually get used
  • Contribute to the architecture and design of our internal systems and services

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.



  • Ei, profissional desenvolvedor Back end , venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

Experiência com Python em ambientes produtivos

Vivência com AWS Lambda , S3 , CloudWatch , DynamoDB , entre outros serviços

Conhecimento em Java , especialmente para leitura e análise de código legado

Experiência com versionamento de código (Git, GitHub/GitLab)

Desejável conhecimento em Terraform , CI/CD , e boas práticas de DevOps

Migrar aplicações e serviços escritos em Java para Python , garantindo performance e escalabilidade

Realizar versionamento e controle de código Python em ambiente AWS

Analisar e otimizar Lambda Functions escritas em Java

Trabalhar com infraestrutura e serviços AWS para suportar a migração e operação dos sistemas

Colaborar com times multidisciplinares para garantir entregas de qualidade




Modelo 100% home office

title: Guidewire Developer (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
A Job? Or a Lifetime Experience? Start Yours Here!


Please note that we're aiming at an expatriation to Portugal.


We are a Portuguese technology consulting company with a strong outward look to the rest of Europe. We have 12 years of experience in the market and reached the status of “large company” in 2018. We now have more than 350 associates and we keep growing, with offices in Lisbon, Porto, and Leiria, as well as projects in more than 20 countries. Our company is part of the national top 10, with a growth of 250% in the last years.


Work-life balance is part of our DNA. We focus on win-win-win relationships, defining every moment of interaction as an experience with unique conditions. Working with Affinity is a “Lifetime Experience” where you will have the opportunity to demonstrate all your potential and to be successful on every level.


#welcometoyourfuture


What you need to have

  • At least 2 years of experience working with Guidewire (PolicyCenter, BillingCenter, or ClaimCenter) ;
  • Strong experience in Guidewire Configuration, Integration, and GOSU development ;
  • Solid understanding of Guidewire Studio , Product Model , and Data Model ;
  • Good level of English (minimum B2 level).
  • Knowledge of Java and REST/SOAP web services is desirable;


What we expect from you

  • Will to exceed expectations (your own and the ones defined by Affinity);
  • Exceptional technical and interpersonal skills;
  • Good people skills (not just in terms of technology, language, and platforms), team spirit, and pleasant disposition;
  • Obsession for doing things right, and ability to prioritize;
  • Ability to adapt and evolve in a fast-changing environment.


What will encourage you

  • Being part of a company that has a disruptive action in the technology market;
  • Being part of a culture focused on relationships, simplicity, and efficiency;
  • Accessing a generative career directly proportional to your performance and interest;
  • The real possibility of being part of our company staff.


Do you think you're the one we are looking for? Let’s chat!

Send your application and take a look at:

title: Senior Java Software Engineer
description:
Join OSF Digital as a Backend Developer, where you will design and build server-side components using Java, ensuring clean and efficient code. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to optimize backend performance and security while contributing to innovative digital experiences for our users.



Job Description


  • Backend Development:

Design and build server-side components, including APIs and databases, using Java and relevant frameworks, ensuring clean and maintainable code.

  • API Work:

Implement and integrate RESTful APIs, manage data validation, and handle errors, possibly integrating with external services.

  • Database Management:

Design and optimize databases for performance, maintain data integrity, and work with various database systems.

  • Testing & QA:

Conduct unit and integration tests to maintain code quality, identify bugs, and optimize performance.

  • Team Collaboration:

Engage with cross-functional teams to meet project goals, requiring strong communication and teamwork skills.


Technical Competencies:


  • Java Programming:

Strong knowledge and experience in the Java programming language. Understanding of core concepts, syntax, and best practices.

  • Server-Side Development:

Experience in building server-side applications and APIs using Java frameworks such as Spring Boot.

  • Relational Databases:

Proficiency in working with relational databases like MySQL, PostgreSQL, or Oracle. Knowledge of SQL, data modeling, and database optimization.

  • Web Development:

Understanding of web development concepts and technologies such as HTTP, RESTful APIs, JSON, and XML.

  • Java Frameworks and Libraries:

Familiarity with popular Java frameworks and libraries such as Spring Framework, Hibernate, or Apache Kafka.

  • Unit Testing:

Experience with unit testing frameworks like JUnit. Knowledge of software testing principles and practices.

  • Version Control:

Proficiency in using version control systems like Git for code management and collaboration.


Analytical and Problem-Solving Competencies:


  • Analytical Skills:

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to identify and resolve issues in the backend code and infrastructure.

  • Performance Optimization:

Knowledge of performance optimization techniques, such as caching, indexing, and query optimization, to ensure efficient and scalable backend systems.


Cloud Experience:

  • Cloud Services:

Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS. Ability to deploy and manage applications in a cloud environment, leveraging cloud services for scalability and performance.



OSF Digital is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, where you can bring your whole self to work. Join an inclusive and passionate community of professionals who help bring about digital transformation for businesses around the world. At OSF Digital, we welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, color, religion, national origin, age, marital status, or any other protected category in any of the jurisdictions in which we conduct business. Explore our opportunities and join us on an amazing journey!

title: Senior Java Software Engineer
description:
Join OSF Digital as a Backend Developer, where you will design and build server-side components using Java, ensuring clean and efficient code. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to optimize backend performance and security while contributing to innovative digital experiences for our users.



Job Description


  • Backend Development:

Design and build server-side components, including APIs and databases, using Java and relevant frameworks, ensuring clean and maintainable code.

  • API Work:

Implement and integrate RESTful APIs, manage data validation, and handle errors, possibly integrating with external services.

  • Database Management:

Design and optimize databases for performance, maintain data integrity, and work with various database systems.

  • Testing & QA:

Conduct unit and integration tests to maintain code quality, identify bugs, and optimize performance.

  • Team Collaboration:

Engage with cross-functional teams to meet project goals, requiring strong communication and teamwork skills.


Technical Competencies:


  • Java Programming:

Strong knowledge and experience in the Java programming language. Understanding of core concepts, syntax, and best practices.

  • Server-Side Development:

Experience in building server-side applications and APIs using Java frameworks such as Spring Boot.

  • Relational Databases:

Proficiency in working with relational databases like MySQL, PostgreSQL, or Oracle. Knowledge of SQL, data modeling, and database optimization.

  • Web Development:

Understanding of web development concepts and technologies such as HTTP, RESTful APIs, JSON, and XML.

  • Java Frameworks and Libraries:

Familiarity with popular Java frameworks and libraries such as Spring Framework, Hibernate, or Apache Kafka.

  • Unit Testing:

Experience with unit testing frameworks like JUnit. Knowledge of software testing principles and practices.

  • Version Control:

Proficiency in using version control systems like Git for code management and collaboration.


Analytical and Problem-Solving Competencies:


  • Analytical Skills:

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to identify and resolve issues in the backend code and infrastructure.

  • Performance Optimization:

Knowledge of performance optimization techniques, such as caching, indexing, and query optimization, to ensure efficient and scalable backend systems.


Cloud Experience:

  • Cloud Services:

Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS. Ability to deploy and manage applications in a cloud environment, leveraging cloud services for scalability and performance.

  • Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB) , com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.  
  • Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem , configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.

  • Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.  
  • Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.


O que nós estamos procurando;    

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.      
  • Experiência solida (+5 anos):  em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, JavaScript e TypeScript.     
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.      
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD , uso de Docker , Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.

title: Inside Sales | Vendas Whatsapp
description:
we are FASHION CLOSET


estamos em busca de uma Inside Sales  com perfil altamente comercial, movida por metas e que domine a arte de vender através do whatsApp. essa pessoa será responsável por conduzir conversas com clientes, entender suas necessidades, apresentar soluções com argumentos persuasivos e garantir que cada atendimento seja uma oportunidade real de conversão.

mais do que vender, queremos alguém que pense estrategicamente a jornada do cliente , use técnicas modernas de negociação e saiba explorar oportunidades de cross-sell e up-sell  com naturalidade e eficiência.


principais responsabilidades

  • realizar atendimentos ativos e receptivos via WhatsApp com foco total em conversão de vendas;
  • dominar técnicas de vendas consultivas, negociação e fechamento;
  • utilizar ferramentas de CRM para gestão do funil e acompanhamento de leads;
  • aplicar estratégias de cross-sell e up-sell em oportunidades reais de negócio;
  • trabalhar com scripts e também construir abordagens personalizadas conforme o perfil do cliente;
  • manter relacionamento contínuo com a base de clientes, entendendo suas necessidades e antecipando soluções;
  • buscar constantemente superar metas e contribuir com ideias que ampliem o faturamento.


requisitos

  • experiência comprovada com vendas via WhatsApp ou Inside Sales (obrigatório);
  • conhecimento em técnicas de vendas consultivas, negociação e fechamento;
  • capacidade de comunicação escrita impecável e abordagem persuasiva;
  • organização e habilidade com ferramentas de CRM;
  • disposição para ir além do básico e entregar resultado acima da média.


diferenciais

  • experiência no segmento de moda feminina;
  • conhecer a Fashion Closet e sua proposta de valor.


oferecemos

  • ambiente dinâmico e inclusivo
  • comissão sobre vendas
  • benefícios


somos uma empresa de moda feminina que busca trazer para as clientes o que há de mais trend no Brasil e mundo afora. focamos em estilo, qualidade, velocidade, sem perder a excelência na experiência da cliente.

aqui na FASHION buscamos pessoas verdadeiras, com brilho nos olhos e inquietas pelo novo.

a nossa missão é criar produtos que elevem a auto estima das clientes e as tornem poderosas.

a nossa missão também é participar positivamente de alguma forma da construção dos sonhos das nossas clientes, colaboradores, fornecedores e sociedade.

vem com a gente!

title: Technical Support Engineer (Infra/Deploy)
description:
About the Project

Our client is a Business Intelligence platform enabling customers to connect multiple data sources (e.g., Excel, SQL) into a unified environment, build interactive dashboards, apply formulas, and customize via plugins, scripts, and embedding. The product supports both SaaS and on-prem deployments. Support is organized into 4 pods: Analytics, DevEx, Data, and Infra.


About Role:

As a Technical Solutions Engineer, you will work with leading enterprise organizations and startups to realize the power of data analytics. Our Technical Solutions team spans the globe and uses the SWARM model for our tools, processes, and organizational structure. This shift focuses on driving a collaborative, rewarding environment that measures value creation and team playing.

Our team is aligned directly with our Product and Engineering teams through a robust Subject Matter Expert program. We are employing best-in-breed tools along with processes co-authored or directly influenced by our team. We believe in the power of great customer experience, and the happiest customers are made by having the happiest team helping them.


Work Hours : PST business hours.


Required skills:

  • Proven hands-on experience supporting a software platform/product in a customer-facing B2B environment.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts in a clear, concise, and professional manner.
  • Hands-on experience with Linux operating systems (Debian and RHEL-based), including package management, service management, log analysis, file permissions, user and process management, and troubleshooting system resources (CPU, memory, disk, I/O).
  • Basic networking knowledge, including OSI,DNS, TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS, SSL/TLS, subnets, routing, and firewall concepts, with ability to troubleshoot using tools like ping, traceroute, curl, or netstat.
  • Understanding of containerisation (images, containers, networking, volumes) and virtualisation (VMs, hypervisors) concepts, and familiarity with orchestration concepts such as deployments, scaling, and service discovery.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes is a strong advantage.


Nice to have:

  • Knowledge of Python or scripting languages such as Bash is a plus.
  • Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases is an advantage.
  • Familiarity with REST APIs is an advantage.
  • Experience with cloud providers (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) is an advantage.


About you:

  • You have a data-driven, analytical mindset with excellent problem-solving skills
  • You are detail-oriented, with the ability to prioritize, multitask, and meet deadlines
  • You demonstrate a proven ability to stay motivated and work effectively both independently and as part of a team
  • You bring a proactive passion for supporting and helping others
  • You have a strong desire to learn, grow, and contribute to the company’s core values of collaboration and service
  • You possess excellent English communication, listening, and writing skills
  • You possess a strong sense towards customer sentiment and adapt your communication style accordingly
  • You are clear in setting expectations and meeting the promised timeline


Scope of work:

  • You will handle customer questions and issues by combining business acumen with technical assessment skills. You will perform troubleshooting of issues both through the UI and the terminal
  • You will work closely with Senior team members to develop your skills and technical expertise within specific areas of the product, with ongoing opportunities to grow
  • You will partner with Customer Success Managers, Technical

title: Senior Infrastructure Linux Engineer (L2 | Production | Market Data | Remote | Brazil)
description:
IMPORTANT: Eligible location is Brazil


Company Description


Amaris Consulting is an independent technology consulting firm with a global footprint, bringing together diverse talents from various backgrounds to deliver innovative solutions to clients worldwide. We are committed to excellence, collaboration, and consistently exceeding performance expectations across a wide range of industries.


Role Description


We are looking for a skilled Senior Linux infrastructure engineer to maintain and enhance the real-time data systems powering one of the world’s leading investment banks as our customer. You will handle alert and incident management, problem resolution, and system improvements, ensuring uptime and performance for global trading and data services.managing and resolving infrastructure issues and ensuring optimal performance of real-time data services.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Resolving Data quality issues, this includes root cause analysis while managing internal and external vendors to resolve Data issues.
  • Support On-call, incident management, problem and change managements.
  • Ensuring optimal accuracy and timeliness of Data on a real-time basis while implementing monitoring tools to detect data issues.
  • Work closely with regional and global Market Data Infrastructure teams to share knowledge and experience to enrich the team's capability and work together to provide a high level quality of services on Market Data.
  • L2 Alert Management. Management of alerts that require knowledge for resolutions, creating and/or updating resolutions into knowledge base, run books, scripts and ITRS rules where possible
  • Incident Management. Managing of incident lifecycle from identification to resolution, ensuring mitigation of business impact in the production environment.
  • Change Management. Management of the process of making production changes to the ticker plant like Mandatory updates which includes content, software changes/upgrades that are performed by vendors or internal teams where only checkouts are necessary.
  • Others: Release Management, Event Management, User support, Reporting.


What We're Looking For?

  • Minimum 7 years of experience in infrastructure, systems, or production support roles
  • Highly skilled in Linux System Administration
  • Experience in Windows operating systems
  • Scripting proficiency (Bash and/or Python preferred)
  • Experience with networking and connectivity skills e.g. multicast , routing, switches, TCP/IP.
  • Good communication and oral and written English skills is a must
  • Understanding of ITIL Foundation and IT Best practices
  • Prior experience in banking, investment, or other financial IT environments is advantageous
  • Skills which are not mandatory but are advantage:


Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with ITRS Geneos , EXEGY (Wombat/Vela) , or Market Data platforms (Refinitiv TREP/RTDS, Bloomberg)
  • Familiarity with AWS ECS , AWS VPC , Google Cloud
  • Experience with GitHub/GitLab and automation pipelines


What We Offer?

  • A modern, dynamic, and future-oriented environment within a top global institution
  • Flexible working arrangements – fully remote or hybrid options
  • Continuous learning and certification opportunities
  • Competitive salary and benefits packagr
  • Long-term career prospects with international exposure
  • Inclusive, multicultural team with regular knowledge-sharing and team events

title: Cientista de Dados
description:
Modelo de trabalho: Remoto

Contratação: CLT


Profissional com sólida experiência em Ciência de Dados e Machine Learning , atuando com IA Generativa , modelos de ponta (estado da arte) e ambiente Databricks . Deve possuir forte capacidade analítica, curiosidade técnica e visão prática de aplicação de modelos para geração de valor ao negócio.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


O profissional atuará em um projeto estratégico de IA Generativa aplicada à BU de Moda , com foco inicial na geração de imagens e vídeos de produtos , troca de fundos e criação de conteúdo multimídia para redes sociais. A iniciativa tem potencial de expansão para os segmentos de vestuário e beleza , visando a construção de soluções escaláveis e inovadoras.


  • Desenvolver e evoluir modelos de Inteligência Artificial voltados à geração e manipulação de imagens (foto realismo, avatares e vídeos).
  • Criar soluções para vitrines virtuais e conteúdos multimídia (ex.: troca de fundos, inserção de produtos em cenários relevantes).
  • Apoiar a construção de ferramentas internas de IA, como inserção de prompts, seleção de roupas e recomendações personalizadas de looks.
  • Atuar em projetos de hiperpersonalização aplicando técnicas de aprendizado de máquina e IA generativa.
  • Conduzir experimentos e testes A/B, avaliando a performance e o impacto de modelos em métricas de negócio.
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares , garantindo qualidade, documentação e versionamento dos projetos de dados e IA.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Ciência de Dados ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência: Mínimo de 3 anos como Cientista de Dados, com foco em Machine Learning (modelos preditivos ou análise de dados em escala).
  • Programação: Proficiência em Python e bibliotecas de ML/DL (TensorFlow, Keras, scikit-learn).
  • Databricks: Vivência prática com workflows de dados, notebooks e MLflow.
  • IA Generativa: Experiência em uso ou fine-tuning de modelos como Stable Diffusion (imagens) e GPT (texto).
  • Colaboração: Experiência com Git e boas práticas de versionamento e documentação.
  • Idiomas: Inglês intermediário (focado em leitura e escrita técnica).


Requisitos Desejáveis

  • Experiência com leitura e implementação de modelos baseados em artigos acadêmicos e técnicas de ponta.
  • Vivência com manipulação de dados em escala (Pandas , Spark ).
  • Conhecimento em experimentação e métricas (A/B testing, avaliação de modelos generativos).
  • Experiência com a plataforma Hugging Face .
  • Noções de otimização de performance (redução de tempo de processamento em batch).


Informações adicionais


O que oferecemos para você?

  • Vale Refeição ou Alimentação;
  • Assistência médica e Odontológica;
  • Convênio Farmácia (descontos na compra de medicamentos);
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • TIVIT Club (descontos e parcerias com as melhores lojas);
  • PAC - Programa de aceleração de carreira;
  • Reembolso para certificações;
  • MOBIFLIX – Nossa academia corporativa tem cursos presenciais e online, alinhados as novas tendências do mercado de tecnologia;
  • Plataforma online de crédito consignado, a TIVIT te ajuda a realizar os seus objetivos pessoais como reforma no seu apê/casa, financiar estudos e quitar dívidas, de acordo com as regras e políticas da cia;
  • Programa de Apoio Pessoal com orientação psicológica, financeira e jurídica em parceria com a Alelo.


Acreditamos que o presente é plural e a inclusão transforma, por isso, todas as pessoas são bem-vindas em nossas vagas, para promovermos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo, de respeito, justiça e equidade.

Topa embarcar nesse desafio com a gente? #vemserTIVIT

O profissional atuará em um projeto estratégico de IA Generativa aplicada à BU de Moda , com foco inicial na geração de imagens e vídeos de produtos , troca de fundos e criação de conteúdo multimídia para redes sociais. A iniciativa tem potencial de expansão para os segmentos de vestuário e beleza , visando a construção de soluções escaláveis e inovadoras.


  • Desenvolver e evoluir modelos de Inteligência Artificial voltados à geração e manipulação de imagens (foto realismo, avatares e vídeos).
  • Criar soluções para vitrines virtuais e conteúdos multimídia (ex.: troca de fundos, inserção de produtos em cenários relevantes).
  • Apoiar a construção de ferramentas internas de IA, como inserção de prompts, seleção de roupas e recomendações personalizadas de looks.
  • Atuar em projetos de hiperpersonalização aplicando técnicas de aprendizado de máquina e IA generativa.
  • Conduzir experimentos e testes A/B, avaliando a performance e o impacto de modelos em métricas de negócio.
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares , garantindo qualidade, documentação e versionamento dos projetos de dados e IA.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Ciência de Dados ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência: Mínimo de 3 anos como Cientista de Dados, com foco em Machine Learning (modelos preditivos ou análise de dados em escala).
  • Programação: Proficiência em Python e bibliotecas de ML/DL (TensorFlow, Keras, scikit-learn).
  • Databricks: Vivência prática com workflows de dados, notebooks e MLflow.
  • IA Generativa: Experiência em uso ou fine-tuning de modelos como Stable Diffusion (imagens) e GPT (texto).
  • Colaboração: Experiência com Git e boas práticas de versionamento e documentação.
  • Idiomas: Inglês intermediário (focado em leitura e escrita técnica).


Requisitos Desejáveis

  • Experiência com leitura e implementação de modelos baseados em artigos acadêmicos e técnicas de ponta.
  • Vivência com manipulação de dados em escala (Pandas , Spark ).
  • Conhecimento em experimentação e métricas (A/B testing, avaliação de modelos generativos).
  • Experiência com a plataforma Hugging Face .
  • Noções de otimização de performance (redução de tempo de processamento em batch).


Informações adicionais


O que oferecemos para você?

  • Vale Refeição ou Alimentação;
  • Assistência médica e Odontológica;
  • Convênio Farmácia (descontos na compra de medicamentos);
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • TIVIT Club (descontos e parcerias com as melhores lojas);
  • PAC - Programa de aceleração de carreira;
  • Reembolso para certificações;
  • MOBIFLIX – Nossa academia corporativa tem cursos presenciais e online, alinhados as novas tendências do mercado de tecnologia;
  • Plataforma online de crédito consignado, a TIVIT te ajuda a realizar os seus objetivos pessoais como reforma no seu apê/casa, financiar estudos e quitar dívidas, de acordo com as regras e políticas da cia;
  • Programa de Apoio Pessoal com orientação psicológica, financeira e jurídica em parceria com a Alelo.


Acreditamos que o presente é plural e a inclusão transforma, por isso, todas as pessoas são bem-vindas em nossas vagas, para promovermos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo, de respeito, justiça e equidade.

Topa embarcar nesse desafio com a gente? #vemserTIVIT

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.



  • Ei, profissional Engenheiro de Dados, venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!


O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


Tecnologias Obrigatórias:

Forte conhecimento em Analytics com AWS e Spark.

Capacidade de entender requisitos de negócio e traduzi-los em soluções técnicas.

Proatividade e autonomia para atuar em projetos complexos.

Boa comunicação para interação com times multidisciplinares, especialmente UX.





Responsabilidades

Criação de pipelines de transformação de dados utilizando AWS Glue e PySpark.

Desenvolvimento de jobs ETL para transformação entre camadas (Bronze, Prata e Ouro) com persistência dos dados no Amazon S3.

Configuração de Glue Crawlers e Data Catalog para as camadas Prata e Ouro.

Orquestração de processos com ferramentas como AWS Step Functions e EventBridge.

Configuração de Kinesis Data Streams e Kinesis Firehose para ingestão de dados.

Utilização do Amazon Athena para consultas analíticas.

Versionamento e deploy de infraestrutura e código via GitHub e Terraform.

Realização de testes de performance de processamento e consultas.

Validação de formatos de dados para integração com aplicações.


Modelo 100% home office

CLT pela BRQ + Pacote de benefícios


- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions
